title: The specified Koszul-to-Cech chain comparison is an isomorphism
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and F an integer-indexed complex of sheaves of modules on Spec(A), all of whose terms are quasi-coherent. The chain map koszulCechComparison A r f F [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction], from the specified Koszul Hom colimit to the principal alternating Cech total, is an isomorphism of A-module complexes.

source.place: Tag 08D1, canonical isomorphism of complexes and its sign calculation

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-koszul-cech-stage-lifting to each total degree. The colimit factorization equation identifies the image of a stage cochain under koszulCechComparison with its specified cocone image. This gives surjectivity in every degree.

Evaluation preserves the complex colimit, and the module forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits (shrunk to indexing universe zero). Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep represents each degreewise source element at a finite stage. If its comparison image is zero, lem-sc-koszul-cech-stage-kernel kills this representative at a later stage. The colimit naturality equation colimit.w then proves the original element is zero; injective_iff_map_eq_zero gives injectivity.

Combine injectivity and surjectivity using ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective in ModuleCat. Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components to obtain invertibility of the chain map. The chain-map sign verification is already part of the specified cocone construction; no inverse construction or new differential calculation is needed here.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08D0 and 08D1: finite-stage lifting and eventual kernel vanishing, combined in Lean with Mathlib filtered-colimit and component-isomorphism APIs; V4.
